# `fluxsim ship`

Run the fidelity gate over every emit that declares a fidelity block, and only if none is withheld, pack the bundle and the run into one evidence archive with its in-toto statements. A run whose plan pins a profile needs it with --profile: it is gated and scored against it, and its scorecard travels in the archive. A bundle that declares consumer queries has them counted for the scorecard's queries dimension, as verify counts them.

## Synopsis

```text
fluxsim ship [options] <bundle>
```

## Examples

```bash
# pack the evidence archive
fluxsim ship ./bundle --run-id de72fa4b22711c52 -o ./out

# a bundle that declares a fidelity block needs the slice it is measured against
fluxsim ship ./bundle --run-id de72fa4b22711c52 -o ./out \
    --committed-slice payment_recovery_moment=file:///data/slice.ndjson
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `bundle` | path to the FLUX bundle directory |

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--run-id` | `RUN_ID` | the run id to act on (as reported by `fluxsim plan`/`fluxsim run`) **(required)** |
| `-o, --out-dir` | `OUT_DIR` | directory the evidence archive and its statements are written to **(required)** |
| `--committed-slice` | `EXPOSE_ID=file://PATH` | the committed real-data slice one expose's fidelity check is measured against, as EXPOSE_ID=file://PATH; repeatable, once per expose; the file holds one JSON object per line, keyed by the expose's contract column names (e.g. {"subscriber_id": "s-1", "amount": "12.50"}) |
| `--profile` | `PATH` | the profile document this run's plan pins (docs/spec/PROFILE-SPEC.md): every declared fidelity property with no --committed-slice is checked against it, and the run is scored per property, table, dimension and overall (docs/spec/SCORECARD-SPEC.md); refused when its digest is not the pinned one, and when the run pins none |
| `--signing-key` | `SIGNING_KEY` | file holding a 32-byte ed25519 seed (raw or hex) to sign fidelity records with; without it the record is signed by a per-invocation key and says so |
| `--trust-key` | `PATH` | file holding the 32-byte raw ed25519 PUBLIC key (raw or hex -- the `publicKey` a fidelity record prints) the gate checks the record's signature against; without it the record is checked against the public half of the key that signed it and says it is self-attested |
| `--held-out` | `FILE` | the held-out profile: a profile document whose queries section holds the targets of the bundle's held-out consumer queries, which the pinned profile may not name; it is graded beside the pinned profile and read by nothing else |
| `--max-query-seconds` | `N` | raise the seconds one consumer query may take above the engine's 30, up to 600, for a bundle that declares no limits.seconds; a bundle's own value is kept and may only lower the ceiling |
| `--max-query-memory` | `SIZE` | raise the memory DuckDB may use for the consumer queries above the engine's 1GiB, up to 16GiB, such as 4GiB, for a bundle that declares no limits.memory; a bundle's own value is kept and may only lower the ceiling |
| `--state-dir` | `STATE_DIR` | run-state directory (default: ./.flux) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
